snippet.description:
Wishlist Last Harbor on Steam Now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369620/Last_Harbor

You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?
